sections.overview: Psednos andriashevi is a small snailfish (family Liparidae) known from the northeast atlantic, west of ireland.
sections.identification: It has no coronal pore, 42 dorsal soft rays and 47 vertebrae. P. anoderkes has 37 rays and 42 vertebrae. P. barnardi has 39–41 rays and 47 vertebrae, plus a black chin.
sections.habitat: It is a marine midwater fish, with records reported to 800 m.
sections.diet: The species account and original description do not report a species-specific diet.
sections.behavior: No behavior is described in the species account.
sections.reproduction: The reviewed species sources do not describe reproduction.
sections.ecology: The known records are sparse; the reported maximum is 5.3 cm standard length.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports it as Data Deficient on the IUCN Red List.

sources.title: A review of the genus Psednos — Chernova (2001)
